notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the shared MovementInfo body (transport/swim-pitch/jump/spline-elevation conditional tails), the six-kind force-speed-change family with CMSG acks, the four granted move modes (root/water-walk/feather-fall/hover) with acks, and the client-uptime timestamp rule. MSUI ports the MovementInfo body byte-for-byte (all four tails, u32 fallTime, uptime clock) and handles root/unroot with acks plus MSG_MOVE_TELEPORT_ACK, but the speed-change and non-root mode families are absent.
